::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/reports/credit_refused_demand"}
#docs
Usage events refused because the customer did not have enough credit, per meter and by `group_by` per day or customer: the events, their quantity in the meter's own unit, and the credits they would have cost. Refused usage is never counted in a usage total, an allowance or a settlement. Range at most 92 days. Needs `credits:view`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | The business's id (biz_…). |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `string` | **yes** | Start, ISO 8601 with an offset. |
| `to` | `string` | **yes** | End (exclusive), ISO 8601 with an offset. |
| `group_by` | `string` | no | Default `meter`. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Rows, 1 to 1000. Default 500. |

| `group_by` | `string` | The credit refused demand's group by. One of `meter`, `day`, `customer`. |
| `time_zone` | `string` | The business time zone the days are cut in. |

| `data.day` | `string` | YYYY-MM-DD, with `group_by=day`. |

| `data.unit` | `string` | The credit unit. |
| `data.refused_events` | `integer` | Events refused. |
| `data.customers` | `integer` | Customers refused. |
| `data.refused_quantity` | `string` | Quantity refused, in the meter's own unit (decimal string). |
| `data.refused_units` | `integer` | Credits it would have cost, in the smallest step. |
| `data.refused_units_decimal` | `string` | The same, in whole units. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
